Requirement gathering 
 Analyze/Understand the business requirements and provide suggestions to customer 
 Design the report 
 Knowledge of entire architecture (eg: interface to Database, .Net, SharePoint etc) vs. just having knowledge only on report part they worked

 
 Technical 
 Professional experience in all aspects of TIBCO  Spotfire  development including Information designer and custom Python scripts. 
 Database queries
 Strong conceptual understanding of relational database systems. 
 Strong ability to understand analytic specifications, translate specifications into TIBCO  Spotfire  visualizations and /or underlying code. 
 Experience with extracting and combining different data sources, different databases and data warehouses 
 Strong ability to develop meaningful and consistent quality checks throughout the development process. 
 Excellent organizational and documentation skills. 
 Experience in developing User Interfaces. 
 

 Specific Technical Skills ranked from most to least important, as follows 
 C#/.NET Framework Development Experience 
 Knowledge of PL/SQL, Oracle, and Relational Databases 
 Python or IronPython Scripting 
 Tibco  Spotfire  and Web player skills and experience 
 Business Intelligence / Data Warehousing 
 Experience programming in R or S+ is a plus 
 

 
 Apply today!
